[[File:SCUBA_trooper_TCWCG.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Clone SCUBA trooper]]
'''Clone SCUBA troopers''', also known as '''clone subtroopers''', were elite [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] assault [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Cloning/Legends|grown]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Trained in underwater tactics and outfitted with specialized [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], clone SCUBA [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were deployed on numerous aquatic battlefields throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], allowing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to challenge marine foes on equal footing. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] led units of clone SCUBA troopers on several occasions over the course of the Clone Wars, with the aquatic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] proving invaluable during [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|two]] [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|battles]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] water-world, [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].

==Description==
[[Cloning/Legends|Born]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="ClonetrooperDB">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> and [[DNA/Legends|genetically]] identical to their more common clone brethren, clone SCUBA [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were an elite group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that underwent specialized training in [[Water/Legends|underwater]] tactics and weaponry for use against aquatic enemies. Outfitted with equipment designed to allow them to wage war effectively while underwater, SCUBA troopers allowed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to even the odds against aquatic enemies.<ref name="DB Entry">{{DB|organization|clonescubatrooper|clone SCUBA trooper}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Scuba_troopers.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Two clone SCUBA troopers in action]]
Like all clone troopers, SCUBA troopers were clones of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="ClonetrooperDB" /> a watery world located in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> While the clones of Fett were all genetically identical, with the exception of the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]],<ref name="GttGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> a few groups were selected to undergo specialized training for combat in specific environments, training supplemented by equally specialized armor. Equipped with state of the art aquatic gear, clone SCUBA troopers were trained within the [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] combat simulators of Kamino's stilt [[City/Legends|cities]] to battle efficiently underwater.<ref name="DB Entry" /><ref name="GttGAR" />

As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]] between the Galactic Republic and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and the CIS equipped itself with [[manta droid subfighter]]s and other aquatic machines&mdash;allying itself with marine races such as the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]]&mdash;it became apparent that the Republic would need to make use of its aquatic soldiers and weapons to combat these new foes.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> One of the earliest engagements that demonstrated the skill of the clone SCUBA troopers was the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]]: the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]] had joined forces with the CIS and its powerful [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], exacerbating the longstanding tension between the Quarren and the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|race]] into a [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|civil war]] which the Republic chose to intervene in on behalf of the still loyal Mon Cal people. Under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], several [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] descended on the planet and an [[Army/Legends|army]] of clone SCUBA troopers followed Fisto into the [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] sea where they met the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] in battle. The aquatic soldiers engaged [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on foot and on [[mini-sub]] mounts, bringing down numerous [[manta droid subfighter]]s and at least one [[Separatist Sub-Carrier]]. The battle soon turned in favor of the Republic when General Fisto [[Force Orb/Legends|destroyed]] the Quarren's massive "[[crab cannon]],"<ref name="CW5">{{CW|5}}</ref> and with it a significant portion of the battle's Quarren leadership. Afterward, Fisto left his SCUBA troops behind on mop-up operations while he personally investigated the presence of the [[Moappa]] and instigated negotiations between the newly discovered [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] race and the Mon Calamari.<ref name="Fierce Currents">{{CWACite|1|Fierce Currents}}</ref>

[[File:CloneSCUBAtrooper-TCWs4BR1.png|thumb|right|180px|A SCUBA trooper wearing [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]]]
At a point further in the war, circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] noticed ecological damage and disturbances to his world that he feared was the work of the Confederacy. Requesting a Republic investigation, General Kit Fisto was dispatched to Rodia with a detachment of clone SCUBA troopers. Taking a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of troopers into the water where the disturbances originated, Fisto ordered another squad of SCUBA troopers to search the surrounding area, led by a [[Unidentified clone SCUBA commander|SCUBA trooper commander]]. The [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander's]] men were ambushed by battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] inside of a nearby abandoned [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Robonino's hideout|base]], but were able overcome the droids and destroy them. In the water, two SCUBA troopers [[Death/Legends|fell]] to [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] fire when the source of the disturbances turned out to be the bounty hunter, [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]]. During the resulting [[Skirmish on Rodia|skirmish]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary's]] hideout was destroyed and Robonino managed to escape, only to be delivered into the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master's]] custody by the grace of luck, courtesy of a native [[Kwazel Maw/Legends|Kwazel Maw]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters Part II">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part II)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part II)]]</ref>

It was also around this point in [[Time/Legends|time]] that the planet of Mon Calamari came under [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|attack]] by Confederacy forces for the second time in the war. Directed by the [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]] commander, [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]], the Confederacy again supported the Quarren people in their attack on the Mon Calamari, while several Grand Army units under [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the returning Kit Fisto came to the Mon Cals' aide. SCUBA trooper clones under the leadership of Commander [[Monnk/Legends|Monnk]] found their skills in just as high demand as they had been during the previous battle on the water world, but victory proved harder the second time. The Republic took heavy casualties during the battle, with the SCUBA troopers requiring support and reinforcement from the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Even still, it took the death of Confederate leader Tamson at the hands of Mon Calamari [[Prince/Legends|prince]], [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], to finally turn the tide away from what seemed like certain victory for the CIS.<ref name="WW">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref><ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>

==Equipment==
{{Quote|You're gagging to wear that scuba trooper's rig, aren't you?|[[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]], to [[Sev/Legends|Sev]]|<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
[[File:SCUBA.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Phase I [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] SCUBA trooper.]]
Clone SCUBA troopers were issued specialized [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]], lighter in weight than the standard armor made up of a [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]]-alloy composite, which was worn by the Grand Army's ground [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] soldiers. These unique suits were outfitted with aquatic propulsion packs worn on the trooper's back,<ref name="DB Entry" /> feet-worn fins,<ref name="CW5" /> and maneuverability jets built into the armor's shin plates for increased agility while underwater. The SCUBA troopers' helmets possessed powerful lenses and [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that allowed the wearer to pierce through potentially murky water and offered a clear image of underwater enemies,<ref name="DB Entry" /> though the internal [[Comlink/Legends|communications]] system amplified even the slightest breath for anyone on the frequency.<ref name="TC" /> The helmets also featured built in miniaturized [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] scrubbers, able to extract viable air from the surrounding water once the wearer was submerged, though external oxygen tanks could also be attached.<ref name="DB Entry" /> This effectively eliminated the need for the wearer to come to the surface for air, allowing SCUBA troopers to remain underwater for lengthy periods of time. Though the SCUBA armor had been developed ''for'', and was primarily used ''by'' clone SCUBA troopers, suits of the armor were also available to members of the Grand Army's [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] for use on aquatic missions, and the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] utilized the armor during their mission to [[Dorumaa]] in search of the rogue [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]].<ref name="TC" /> Additionally, clone SCUBA troopers were equipped with specialized [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]],<ref name="DB Entry" /> similar in design to the clone army's standard [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]],<ref name="CW5" /> that possessed a modified [[collimator barrel array]], responsible for reducing the speed of blaster bolt diffuse in a water environment. SCUBA troopers were also issued explosive ordnance designed to capitalize on water's ability to transmit concussive shock.<ref name="DB Entry" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CloneSCUBATrooperConcept.png|thumb|350x350px|SCUBA Trooper concept for [[Water War]].]]
Clone SCUBA troopers first appeared in a cameo in the [[Chapter 1 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|first chapter]] before prominently featuring in the [[Chapter 5 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|fifth chapter]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' micro-series, which first aired in [[2003]]. Details about these aquatic troops were later provided in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for the SCUBA troopers on [[StarWars.com]], in addition to receiving mentions in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''.

SCUBA troopers were mentioned several times in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel, ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], and their armor was utilized by several of the clone [[Commando/Legends|commando]] protagonists. In [[2011]], the clone SCUBA troopers would appear in a prominent role again in the opening trilogy of episodes for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, comprised of the episodes ''[[Water War]]'', ''[[Gungan Attack]]'', and ''[[Prisoners]]''.

The word "SCUBA" is a real-world acronym, meaning '''S'''elf-'''C'''ontained '''U'''nderwater '''B'''reathing '''A'''pparatus.
